content.text: Memory of a Killer Season 2 Renewal Status Explained: Will Patrick Dempsey Return As Angelo Doyle?When Memory of a Killer landed on Fox on Jan. 25, 2026, it brought with it one of the more gripping premises of the season. Dempsey plays Angelo Doyle, a contract killer quietly losing his grip on reality as early-onset Alzheimer’s starts closing in. The show draws from the 2003 Belgian film De Zaak Alzheimer and a 1985 novel of the same name. It’s dark, layered, and it hooked enough viewers to prompt the inevitable follow-up question.Season 1 is still playing out, episode nine, Shoot The Piano Player, drops March 30, but the renewal conversation has already started. Fox hasn’t said a word officially.
